title: World Cup final scorers since 1994
brief: Name any player who scored in a World Cup final from 1994 to 2026. Shoot-out penalties don't count.

notes.Roberto Baggio: Roberto Baggio missed in the 1994 shoot-out; the final itself was 0-0.
notes.Fabio Grosso: Fabio Grosso scored the winning shoot-out penalty in 2006, which doesn't count.
notes.Gonzalo Montiel: Gonzalo Montiel scored the winning shoot-out penalty in 2022, which doesn't count.
notes.Thomas Muller: Thomas Muller never scored in a final.
notes.Miroslav Klose: Miroslav Klose never scored in a final.
notes.Nico Williams: Nico Williams set up Ferran Torres's winner in 2026 but didn't score.
notes.Geoff Hurst: Geoff Hurst's hat-trick was in 1966, before 1994.

checks: Scorers taken from each final's match box and checked against the finals list's scores (1994 0-0, 1998 3-0, 2002 2-0, 2006 1-1, 2010 1-0, 2014 1-0, 2018 4-2, 2022 3-3, 2026 1-0): the goals add up in every final. Mandzukic scored an own goal and a goal in 2018; he counts for the goal. Ferran Torres is also in the 2026 goalscorer list.
